message.text: The frontend hook is `web/src/connect.ts`, where `createClient` generates the `memoServiceClient` and its `createMemo` method.

`useCreateMemo` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` (`MemoService` from `web/src/connect.ts`). That is `rpc CreateMemo` in the proto, handled by `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, which calls `Store.CreateMemo`, then `DB.CreateMemo` (`INSERT INTO memo`). MySQL/Postgres have the same driver method in `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`.
